rationale: This record is a short biographical guest-editor profile of Richard Browdie focusing on elder care, transportation, dementia programs and home and community-based services at the Pennsylvania Department of Aging. It is completely unrelated to water or sanitation service access (E01) and presents no empirical study or systematic review.
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both narrow and plain readings because the record is a guest-editor profile on elder-care and aging services in Pennsylvania with no relation to household or community water or sanitation service access.

evidence_quotes.quote: Johnson profiles Richard Browdie, who has worked for thirty years for the good of the older people through management of government and community care organizations.

during his tenure, the Department of Aging's network of assistance to families caring for older relatives and friends, transportation, dementia programs, and home and community-based services grew substantially.
